description: Splits text into chunks of at most max_chars (100-20000, default 2000) preferring paragraph, line, sentence and word boundaries, with optional overlap (up to half of max_chars). Sizes are UTF-16 code units; surrogate pairs (emoji) are never split. Input up to 250000 characters. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

overlap.description: Characters repeated between consecutive chunks (default 0, capped at max_chars/2).

name: text.chunk
title: Chunk text for RAG
